about_the_game:
Step onto the battlefield and experience a first taste of Army Troop Remastered!

Battle across one authentic WW2 map with a focused loadout: the iconic Kar98 rifle, P8 pistol, and the classic MK2 grenade. Jump into action with online PvP, fight alongside or against advanced AI bots, or set up private matches with friends to test your skills in Team Deathmatch and Free-for-All modes.

🔥 Demo Highlights

  • One fully playable WW2 map

  • Weapons: Kar98 rifle, P8 pistol, MK2 grenade

  • Online PvP with matchmaking

  • Private matches with friends

  • Advanced AI bots for solo or mixed play

  • Team Deathmatch & Free-for-All modes

⚔️ Full Game Features

  • Multiple soldier classes: Infantry, Recon, Tank Crew, Paratrooper, and more

  • A wide arsenal of rifles, SMGs, LMGs, snipers, and sidearms

  • Customization: perks, weapon skins, scopes, silencers, and accessories

  • More WW2 maps, game modes, and ongoing content updates

  • Smarter AI and full matchmaking for every mode

Try the demo today and wishlist the full version of Army Troop Remastered to be ready for the complete WW2 FPS experience at launch!
